subject: defusedxml

subject: typing_extensions

subject: certifi
why: accepted (owner 2026-10-10, open question 21; ADR-0187 decision 193): the CA bundle; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft (obligations only if its files are modified; they are not). Admitted only while unmodified: the gate checks every file of the distribution against its wheel RECORD hash (decision 194).

subject: tqdm

subject: cffi
